Subject: Need help with a anticipatory bail case

Hello, my name is Vandana Rathore. I am a 71-year-old orthopaedic surgeon living in Vadodara. Abhishek Swamy has filed a police complaint against me over Rs 73,10,000, and the complaint alleges negligence during treatment. My case number is Anticipatory Bail Application No. 955/2019 in the Vadodara Sessions Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 88954 10986 or email vandana.rathore@example.com.
